$shopId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['role', 'active']) && newData.child('role').isString() && newData.child('active').isBoolean() && (newData.child('role').val() == 'SUPER_ADMIN' || newData.child('role').val() == 'ADMIN' || newData.child('role').val() == 'MANAGER' || newData.child('role').val() == 'EMPLOYEE' || newData.child('role').val() == 'VIEWER')

private..write: auth != null && auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider == 'google.com' && auth.token.email_verified == true && root.child('shopMemberships').child(auth.uid).child($shopId).child('active').val() == true && root.child('shopMemberships').child(auth.uid).child($shopId).child('role').val() == 'SUPER_ADMIN'
